LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD follows the standard AUR pattern for packaging a Ruby gem. The sole source is the package's own declared upstream artifact (`https://rubygems.org/downloads/ruby-qt6-qtuitools-$pkgver.gem`), pinned to a specific version and verified with a real sha256 checksum (not `SKIP`). The `build()` function performs a local-only `gem install --local --ignore-dependencies` into a staging directory, and `package()` copies those files into `$pkgdir` and installs the license. All operations are standard `makepkg` practices.

There are no network fetches beyond the declared source, no `eval`/`base64`/obfuscation, no writes outside `$pkgdir`/`tmp_install`, and no privileged or system-modifying commands. Nothing deviates from routine gem packaging. No malicious behavior identified.
</details>
